title: A Logarithmic-Depth Quantum Multiplier
summary: We present a quantum algorithm for multiplying two $n$-bit integers with overall circuit depth and $T$-depth both bounded by $O(\log n)$, while using $O(n^2)$ gates and ancillary qubits. Our construction generates partial products via indicator-controlled copying and adds them using a tree of reversible $3$-to-$2$ adders followed by one quantum carry-lookahead adder. Building on the carry-save adders of Kim et al., we combine full input fanout, workspace reuse, and phase-corrected gate implementations to reduce $T$-depth.
